composition_label: Journey recommendations -> Guided onboarding (general-purpose basic) -> Product comparison; financial services

construction.implementation_origin: New isolated implementation written from scratch, with no other build or repository files read or copied.

input.customer: Identity, synthetic account, KYC status and screening flags, AML flags, and nonnegative cost/affordability/term weights with positive total.
input.loan_application: Linked customer ID, positive amount and monthly budget, EUR/USD/GBP currency, desired whole term in months.
input.transaction_ledger: format=json with record list, or format=csv with inline CSV text. Columns: id,date,amount,currency,direction,account; optional card_number.
input.payment_payload: Demonstrative Document.CstmrCdtTrfInitn.MsgId and CdtTrfTxInf list containing PmtId, ReqdExctnDt, Amt.InstdAmt/Ccy, DbtrAcct.IBAN and CdtrAcct.IBAN.
input.products: ID/name, matching currency, APR percent/basis_points, monthly fee currency_per_month/cents_per_month, term months/years, positive minimum and maximum amounts.

output.context: Canonical customer, application, masked normalized transactions, reconciled ledger summary and normalized products.

error.error: Input validation or file access failed.

shared_schema.validation: Validator.input and Validator.envelope share all schema and financial validation. Every stage validates its input handoff and output; expected journey, onboarding gate, comparison request and scores are recomputed to reject tampering. Unknown external fields and duplicate JSON keys are rejected.
shared_schema.limits: Maximum 2,000,000 input characters, 1,000 combined transactions, 100 products, 20 flags per screen, 600 term months. Money has at most two decimals. No nonfinite or boolean numeric values.

cross_stage_handoffs.validated_data: Customer/application IDs, prerequisite-aware two-step plan, next action, screening blockers, amount, desired term and preferences.
cross_stage_handoffs.behavior: Onboarding consumes the recommended action, personalizes instructions, completes preparation only when screening is clear, and otherwise requests human review without pretending checks were completed.

cross_stage_handoffs.validated_data: Comparison-ready gate, screening blockers, linked application ID, amount, currency, budget, term and preferences.
cross_stage_handoffs.behavior: Comparison consumes only the validated request. Blocked profiles produce no product scores. Ready profiles get normalized side-by-side attributes, amount-eligibility exclusions and explained preference ranking.

behavior.journey: Exactly two validated projected steps: prepare_comparison or clear_profile, followed by compare_products. Projected prerequisite satisfaction is explicitly not real completion.
behavior.onboarding: General-purpose personalized next action with ready/requires_review state and validated downstream request. Screening flags are never automatically cleared.
behavior.comparison: Preference components for cost, affordability and term are weighted by normalized preferences. Ties break by product ID. Empty catalogs and no eligible products return explicit outcomes.
behavior.explainability: Every component score includes formula, inputs, raw weight, total weight, normalized weight and weighted contribution. Final score is the sum of six-decimal rounded contributions. Payments disclose the flat-interest approximation and unrounded estimate.
industry_constraints: Pending/rejected KYC, KYC screening flags or AML flags block comparison; flags remain intact.
Demonstrative PCI DSS-style masking exposes only the last four card digits in all stage outputs; errors never echo inputs or file paths.
Not a compliance certification, credit approval, creditworthiness model, or financial advice.
behavior.synthetic_fixture: All customers, products and account/IBAN identifiers are fabricated and labeled SYNTH. IBANs intentionally cannot route real payments. The fake card is demonstrative. Six ledger amounts were generated using random.Random(63), randint(1500,45000)/100, then frozen in the fixture. Runtime remains deterministic.
behavior.formats: JSON and inline CSV transaction ledgers normalize identically. ISO 20022-style JSON is a deliberately small illustrative subset, not a standards-conformant message.
behavior.cli: One JSON object to stdout, exit 0 on valid requests including blocked business outcomes; JSON status=error and exit 2 for file/validation errors. No diagnostic input echo.

included: One integrated deterministic pipeline and shared validation layer
Personalized discovery and general-purpose guided onboarding
Financial attribute normalization, side-by-side comparison and preference ranking
Synthetic customer/KYC, randomized transaction history and loan application
Unit tests and subprocess CLI validation
excluded: External dependencies, network calls, model providers and agents
Real KYC/AML screening, identity verification or sanctions databases
PCI DSS certification, real account validation, real card processing
Production ISO 20022 validation or payment execution
Credit underwriting, loan approval, amortized lender quotes or investment advice
Persistent customer databases, interactive UI and enterprise operations
LLM integration; no model is needed for this bounded deterministic implementation

unittest.coverage: Each stage, projected prerequisites, personalization, both handoffs, tampering, deterministic nonmutation, unit normalization, score reconciliation and independent formula check, empty inputs, budget/range edges, JSON/CSV parity, ISO-style ingestion, screening flags, card masking, invalid values, and CLI success/errors.

cli.stdout: One valid JSON object with status=ok and stage=comparison.
cli.error_contract: Subprocess tests confirmed missing file and usage failures exit 2 with status=error JSON. In-memory CLI tests confirmed malformed JSON and invalid schemas also exit 2 without sensitive input echo.
